# Test fonts

DejaVu Sans and DejaVu Sans Mono 2.37, unmodified. They are used by the overlay-fit and
degrade-composition tests, which render real drawtext with FFmpeg.

- Source: `https://github.com/dejavu-fonts/dejavu-fonts/releases/download/version_2_37/dejavu-fonts-ttf-2.37.zip`
  (archive SHA-256 `7576310b219e04159d35ff61dd4a4ec4cdba4f35c00e002a136f00e96a908b0a`).
- `DejaVuSansMono.ttf`: SHA-256 `b4a6c3e4faab8773f4ff761d56451646409f29abedd68f05d38c2df667d3c582`.
- `DejaVuSans.ttf`: SHA-256 `7da195a74c55bef988d0d48f9508bd5d849425c1770dba5d7bfc6ce9ed848954`.
- Licence: Bitstream Vera Fonts licence plus DejaVu changes in the public domain. See
  `LICENSE`, which must ship with the fonts. It permits redistribution when the notices
  are kept.
